name: Kelola User & Role
implementation_notes: First-time implementation (never built before this round) — no new migration needed, the `users` table already had every field this screen manages (username, password_hash, name, role, business_unit_id, is_active) from project bootstrap

No delete()/DELETE endpoint at all — users are only ever deactivated (is_active=false), never removed, to preserve referential integrity on created_by/checked_by/acknowledged_by across every other entity in the system

PATCH /api/users/:id/status is a separate endpoint from PATCH /api/users/:id specifically so the list's one-click Aktifkan/Nonaktifkan toggle can never accidentally change name/role/business_unit_id, and so the 409 CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_SELF guard has a single, obvious place to live

update() never accepts or touches password_hash — password changes are the existing self-service Ganti Password screens' (screen-003/004) domain, not this screen's; UserService::validate() only requires/validates username+password on create(), not update(), to avoid incorrectly demanding a username on an update payload that never carries one

business_unit_id requirement is conditional on role via Rule::requiredIf() — required for operator/supervisor/mill_management, optional for admin, both server-side (UserService) and client-side (KelolaUserRole::rules(), re-evaluated live via wire:model.live on the role field so the Business Unit field appears/disappears immediately)

Sidebar 'Kelola User & Role' link added to all 19 other shell-sidebar views in this codebase (consistent with the Mills Setting/Laporan Manajemen sidebar passes earlier this session), positioned after 'Mills Setting' and before 'Data Browser Weighbridge'

kc-* CSS class set reused verbatim from kelola-business-unit.blade.php per this codebase's established convention (copy, not duplicate-and-rename); one addition specific to this screen: kc-badge__active/inactive for the status pill, which has no equivalent in the master-data screens
Independently verified: full backend regression `php artisan test` — 877/877 passed (28 new for this screen, 849 pre-existing unaffected)
